prompt: Close-up at a supermarket checkout under hard fluorescent light: a pair of worn, cold hands with chipped nails opens a cheap, scuffed purse over the counter, and it is empty except for a few copper coins in the bottom. Beside it on the conveyor sit a loaf of white bread, a pint of milk and a tin of beans, the only shopping. The purse is in sharp focus, the rest falls softly away; the hands hesitate. Cold greenish fluorescent cast, documentary realism, fine digital grain. No faces, no readable text anywhere. Tall portrait frame.
